message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Short-Term Earnings Acceleration", "construction": "Difference between the most recent quarter's year-over-year earnings growth rate and the previous quarter's year-over-year earnings growth rate, using Compustat quarterly earnings data.", "rationale": "Firms with accelerating earnings growth may signal improved fundamentals not yet reflected in prices.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Unexpected Inventory Change", "construction": "Current quarter's change in inventory (from Compustat) minus average quarterly inventory change over the past 8 quarters, scaled by total assets.", "rationale": "Unexpected inventory buildups or drawdowns may indicate future sales surprises or supply chain signals.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Cash Flow Over Accruals", "construction": "Ratio of operating cash flow (from Statement of Cash Flows) to total accruals (earnings minus cash flow), measured over the trailing four quarters.", "rationale": "Firms generating a larger share of their earnings in cash may be less prone to earnings manipulation and future disappointments.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Insider Purchase Intensity", "construction": "Number of shares purchased by insiders over the past six months divided by total shares outstanding, using SEC Form 4 data.", "rationale": "Insider buying may reflect private information about undervaluation or positive future prospects.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "R&D to Capex Shift", "construction": "Change in the ratio of R&D expense to capital expenditures over the past three years, using Compustat annual data.", "rationale": "A shift toward R&D investment may signal a firm’s strategic pivot to high-growth opportunities.", "higher_returns_for": "high positive changes in the measure"}, {"name": "Relative Analyst Forecast Dispersion", "construction": "Standard deviation of one-year-ahead analyst earnings forecasts divided by mean forecast, using I/B/E/S data, relative to the firm’s own 3-year history.", "rationale": "Decreasing forecast dispersion relative to history may indicate emerging consensus and reduced uncertainty.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with lower current dispersion vs their own history"}, {"name": "Deferred Tax Asset Proportion", "construction": "Deferred tax assets as a percent of total assets, from Compustat annual data.", "rationale": "High deferred tax assets may reflect aggressive accounting or persistent losses, potentially predicting lower returns.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Gross Margin Stability", "construction": "Standard deviation of gross margin (gross profit/sales) over trailing 12 quarters.", "rationale": "Stable gross margins may indicate strong competitive positioning and pricing power.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Share Repurchase Yield", "construction": "Cash spent on share repurchases during the past year divided by average market capitalization, using Compustat and CRSP data.", "rationale": "Firms actively repurchasing shares may signal undervaluation or confidence in future cash flows.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Dividend Initiation Signal", "construction": "Binary indicator for firms that initiate a regular cash dividend in the past four quarters (Compustat dividend data).", "rationale": "Dividend initiation can serve as a signal of management’s confidence in future profitability and cash flows.", "higher_returns_for": "firms that recently initiated a dividend"}]}
